summary.name: BetterTouchTool
summary.one_liner: BetterTouchTool is a Mac utility for customizing trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures, keyboard shortcuts, the menu bar and other input actions.
use_cases: Assign trackpad gestures to launch or control apps
Snap and resize windows with trackpad taps
Open a clipboard manager with a gesture
Remap mouse buttons and keyboard shortcuts on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: BetterTouchTool maps multi-finger gestures on a MacBook trackpad, Magic Trackpad or Magic Mouse to actions the user chooses. The page lists examples such as three-finger click for middle click, three-finger swipe up to show a clipboard manager, and four-finger swipe down to quit an app. It also supports tap gestures for switching browser tabs, hiding apps, or toggling full screen. Drawing a letter such as "C" can open an app, and tapping near a window edge can snap and resize the window. The meta description and the listing also mention keyboard shortcuts, the menu bar, and mouse input customization.
notable: Tap near window edge to snap and resize windows
Works with MacBook trackpad, Magic Trackpad and Magic Mouse
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page text provided
Only macOS is named, and the gestures depend on Apple trackpad or Magic Mouse hardware
